full_text:
ADDENDUM (Presidential Decree Partially Amending 306 Statutes or Regulations to Reflect the Reorganization of Government Organizations) <No. 35811, October 1, 2025>
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That where the amendments made by this Decree affect a Presidential Decree promulgated before the enforcement of this Decree but not yet in force, the relevant amendment shall enter into force on the enforcement date of that Presidential Decree.
